edge.title: Swap KL-SOAP for plain SOAP; power-1.25 hidden LR decay to step 3200
edge.summary: Replaces KL-SOAP with standard SOAP inside the same hyperball step: the eigenbasis comes from plain Shampoo statistics (L ← 0.9L + 0.1·GGᵀ, R ← 0.9R + 0.1·GᵀG, with no KL whitening or eigenvalue tracking) refreshed every step by one power-iteration + QR, momentum 0.95 is kept in parameter space, and an Adam second moment (EMA 0.9, eps 1e-8, no bias correction) lives in the eigenbasis. Effective betas match #19 (0.95/0.9/0.9), and the first step now updates the weights instead of only initializing state. The hidden LR becomes (1 − step/3200)^1.25, a power-law decay over a 3200-step horizon cut off at 3125 steps (final hidden LR ≈0.9% of peak), while aux AdamW keeps its linear last-40% cooldown.

changes.label: Shampoo factors instead of KL-Shampoo
changes.detail: soap_update: left_buffer ← 0.9·L + 0.1·G Gᵀ and right_buffer ← 0.9·R + 0.1·Gᵀ G (addmm, unnormalized); the KL-whitened targets and eigen_sqrt_inv estimates of #19 are gone.

changes.label: Momentum kept in parameter space
changes.detail: momentum_buffer (lerp 0.05 toward G) stays in the original basis and is projected with the current Q each step, so refreshes need no rotation; square_buffer (0.9 EMA of (Q_Lᵀ G Q_R)²) stays in the eigenbasis unrotated; U = Q_L·(M̃/(√V + 1e-8))·Q_Rᵀ.

changes.label: Basis init/refresh; no init-only step
changes.detail: _init_state sets Q from eigh of the first G Gᵀ and Gᵀ G (factor buffers start at 0) and the same step updates W; _refresh_q does Q ← QR(L·Q) every q_freq = 1 steps after the update is computed.

changes.label: Power-1.25 hidden LR decay to 3200
changes.detail: Hidden groups get schedule_steps = lr_steps = 3200, lr_power = 1.25, lr_floor = 0 in the _eta helper (verbatim from #25), i.e. eta = (1 − step/3200)^1.25 from step 0; AdamW keeps schedule_steps = 3125, power 1, floor 0 (linear, last 40%).

changes.label: Distribution, compile and seeding
changes.detail: Round-robin parameter ownership with a per-param dist.broadcast (was padded all_gather), numel sort, torch.compile on soap_update, closure/sparse checks, SOAP_SEED env (default 1).

hparams_changed.label: basis statistics
hparams_changed.from: KL-Shampoo: G R̂⁻¹ Gᵀ/cols (+ eigenvalue EMAs)
hparams_changed.to: Shampoo: EMA of G Gᵀ / Gᵀ G

edge.parent_check: consistent with declared #19, which is also the nearest code (363 changed lines; the optimizer was rewritten). The schedule helper _eta is verbatim from sibling #25 (power + floor form), so #25 is an influence; #27 uses power 1.25, no floor, hidden groups only, horizon 3200.
edge.noise: SOAPH is written as a general torch.optim class (closure, sparse/2-D checks, hyperparameter print), uses round-robin broadcast instead of all_gather, sorts by numel, compiles soap_update, and renames the seed env to SOAP_SEED.

hparams.schedule.kind: hidden: (1 − step/3200)^1.25; aux: flat then linear over last 40%
hparams.init.proj: LM head proj.weight = 0; block proj weights non-zero

mechanisms.name: SOAP-H (SOAP + hyperball)
mechanisms.explain: Each matrix keeps Shampoo factor EMAs L = EMA(G Gᵀ) and R = EMA(Gᵀ G) (beta 0.9) and an eigenbasis Q_L, Q_R advanced by one power-iteration + QR per step. The momentum (0.95) is projected into the current basis, divided elementwise by the root of an Adam second moment kept in that basis (0.9, eps 1e-8), and rotated back. The resulting SOAP direction is passed to the hyperball step at lr 0.018.

mechanisms.name: Power-law hidden LR decay
mechanisms.explain: _eta returns floor + (1−floor)·x^power with x = 1 − step/schedule_steps for cooldown_frac 1.0. The hidden groups use power 1.25, floor 0 and a 3200-step horizon, so the LR falls faster than linear early and ends at ≈0.9% of peak when training stops at 3125; aux AdamW keeps power 1 over 3125 steps.

caveats: All six runs were on a single H100 NVL (world_size 1, 8 accumulated micro-batches), unlike most records. The README's 'w.o. bias correction' is not a change from #19, which had none either; under the hyperball step it would only rescale the update uniformly. beta2 and the Shampoo factor beta are one shared ema_beta = 0.9.
